rationale: The user asked to exchange a bookshelf from the most recent order for a camera not exceeding the bookshelf’s price. The agent did not authenticate the user in the conversation, did not verify or act on the order, did not present camera options within the price, did not seek confirmation for any order-changing action, and did not initiate any permitted process (e.g., setting up a return/exchange if eligible). Instead, it deferred with a generic “check back once delivered” and an unsupported promise to remind the user, providing no concrete next steps or tool-backed information. This fails the pass bar due to missing required actions and not completing the request per policy.
